summary: CRITICAL: run-act-tests.ps1 references non-existent Docker image 'act-ubuntu-pwsh:latest' (line 10). No Dockerfile provided despite comment at line 82 stating it should be 'built via Dockerfile.act'. Task requires 'ALL TESTS MUST RUN THROUGH ACT' and 'act-result.txt MUST exist'—this deliverable cannot satisfy those hard requirements. Core PowerShell code is solid (module structure, error handling, glob logic) and workflow YAML is sound, but test harness is broken and will fail immediately when invoked.
